subject: Mutual roadmap: final sign-off & signature readiness for Kindred Health
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <epark@kindredhealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@kindredhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + mutual roadmap (draft attached)

Hi Elena / Carlos — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce API inference costs and ensure 99% availability for patient-facing features.
- Integration points: embeddings for search and open-ended generation for summaries.
- Security needs: SOC2 evidence, VPC option, and key rotation controls.

Attached: first-pass "Mutual Roadmap" (MAP) — outlines milestones, owners, and target dates.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Review MAP v1 and flag any missing milestones or dependencies (owner: Kindred).
2) Redwood to provide SOW draft and security snapshot (owner: Redwood) — attached.
3) Schedule legal sync if procurement needs redlines (owner: Kindred Legal / Redwood Legal).

Target commercial cadence
- Aim to sign by May 14 and target limited go-live (pilot) the week of June 1 — flexible based on procurement.

Please confirm: who from your side should be the primary signatory and who will own integration testing? If it helps, I can convert the MAP into a DocuSign-ready packet.

Attachments: Kindred_MUTUAL_ROADMAP_v1.pdf (draft), SOW_Kindred_Redwood_draft.docx, redwood-security-snapshot.pdf

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Park <epark@kindredhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@kindredhealth.com>, Rebecca Li <rebecca.li@kindredhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + mutual roadmap (draft attached)

Hi Connor — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and a few asks: 

Owners / signatory
- Primary signatory: Rebecca Li (Legal). Procurement lead: Carlos Mendes. Integration owner: Elena Park (platform).

Feedback on MAP v1
- Please add a milestone for "Data residency checklist" — Kindred requires confirmation of where logs/secrets are stored.
- UAT success criteria: include a quantitative latency goal (p95 < 300ms) and sample throughput target (100 req/s sustained).
- Add a slot for a 2-week pilot (production-like traffic) before full roll.

Timing constraints
- Procurement needs a final SOW and license terms to start PO process by May 12 to hit our end-of-month budget window.

Can you send an updated MAP with those items? If you can get us a DocuSign-ready packet and the SOW by EOD Tuesday (May 5), I'll run to legal immediately.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Platform Engineering Manager | Kindred Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: action items from Kindred feedback

Connor — quick internal note following Elena's reply. Items for our team: 

1) Add Data Residency milestone and owner (Security / Infra) — ask infra to confirm log retention location and whether we can offer EU-hosted option if required. Owner: Jasmine (SE).
2) UAT success criteria — incorporate p95 < 300ms and 100 req/s throughput into MAP; Jasmine to validate with benchmarks and propose instance profile.
3) SOW updates: legal redline to include PO timeline and signature block for Kindred. Owner: Rishi (Legal liaison).
4) DocuSign packaging: Connor to prepare final MAP + SOW into single envelope once updated.

I'll ping Infra and Legal now. Keep the May 12 procurement deadline top of mind.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <epark@kindredhealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@kindredhealth.com>, Rebecca Li <rebecca.li@kindredhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: UPDATED: Mutual roadmap (v2) + SOW bundle — ready for review and signature

Hi Elena / Rebecca / Carlos — attached is MAP v2 and an updated SOW per Elena's notes. Highlights: 

Milestones (high level)
- M1: Security & data residency confirmation — owner: Redwood Security (Jasmine) — target: 2026-05-07
- M2: SOW finalization & legal sign-off — owner: Kindred Legal / Redwood Legal (Rishi) — target: 2026-05-10
- M3: Dedicated capacity reservation (reserved pool) — owner: Redwood Ops — target: 2026-05-12 (to meet procurement window)
- M4: Integration & data onboarding + 2-week pilot (prod-like) — owner: Kindred Platform / Redwood SE — target start: 2026-05-20
- M5: Go-live (tiered rollout) — owner: Kindred Product / Redwood Delivery — target: 2026-06-02

Success criteria (explicit)
- p95 inference latency < 300ms for summary endpoint under pilot load
- 100 req/s sustained throughput during pilot with error rate < 1%
- Supportability: 24/7 on-call handover for first 2 weeks of pilot

Dependencies
- Procurement PO or signed agreement by 2026-05-12
- Redlined SOW acceptance by 2026-05-10
- Access to a staging dataset and API keys for integration by 2026-05-14

Attachments: Kindred_MUTUAL_ROADMAP_v2.pdf, SOW_Kindred_Redwood_draft.docx, redwood-security-snapshot.pdf

If those dates look good, I will package the MAP + SOW into DocuSign and send to Rebecca for signature today. Let me know if there are any last-minute changes.

Thanks — Connor
(Attachment: Kindred_MUTUAL_ROADMAP_v2.pdf)

From: Rebecca Li <rebecca.li@kindredhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <epark@kindredhealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@kindredhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UPDATED: Mutual roadmap (v2) + SOW bundle — ready for review and signature

Connor — reviewed the package. Thanks for tightening the dates and adding explicit success criteria. A few quick confirmations from Legal / Procurement: 

- The data residency language is acceptable pending Jasmine's confirmation of where logs will be stored; please provide the technical note referenced in the security snapshot by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement can issue a PO if we receive the DocuSign agreement today and legal signs off on the final redlines.
- We are prepared to sign (Rebecca Li) once DocuSign arrives. Target PO issuance: 2026-05-12 as requested.

Please send the DocuSign envelope to rebecca.li@kindredhealth.com and cc carlos.mendes@kindredhealth.com. We'll route it through procurement immediately and loop in accounting for the PO.

Thanks — Rebecca
Rebecca Li
Sr. Counsel | Kindred Health
